original:
Theorem 3.

Let $G$ be a connected graph with $m$ edges and $n$ vertices. If $G$ is

(a) 

loopless and $m\leq 1.64(n-1),$ then $T_{G}(1,1)\leq T_{G}(2,0).$
type: ∀ (V : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [Fintype V] [inst : Fintype E] (G : Graph V E), G.toSimpleGraph.Connected → G.Loopless → ↑G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ 1.64 * (↑G.vertexSet.ncard - 1) → Mathlib2.x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 ≤ Mathlib2.x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0

theorem x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux1 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (n : ℕ) (hbase : 1 + (n : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ n)
    (hstep : a ≤ (b - 1) * (1 + (n : ℝ) * a)) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, n ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k := by
  intro k hk
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact hbase
  | succ k hk ih =>
    have hlin : 1 + (n : ℝ) * a ≤ 1 + (k : ℝ) * a := by
      simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (n : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hk) ha) 1
    have hs : a ≤ (b - 1) * (1 + (k : ℝ) * a) :=
      hstep.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlin (sub_nonneg.mpr hb))
    calc
      1 + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a = (1 + (k : ℝ) * a) + a := by push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ) * a) * b := by nlinarith [hs]
      _ ≤ (2 * b ^ k) * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (by linarith)
      _ = 2 * b ^ (k + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

theorem x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux2 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (p q m r : ℕ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hab : b ^ p ≤ a ^ q) (hmr : q * m ≤ p * r) :
    b ^ m ≤ a ^ r := by
  apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (pow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ b) _) (pow_nonneg ha _) hq).mp
  calc
    (b ^ m) ^ q = b ^ (q * m) := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm m q]
    _ ≤ b ^ (p * r) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hb hmr
    _ = (b ^ p) ^ r := by rw [pow_mul]
    _ ≤ (a ^ q) ^ r := pow_le_pow_left₀ (pow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ b) _) hab r
    _ = (a ^ r) ^ q := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm q r]

theorem x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux3 {V E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (G : Graph V E) (x y : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    0 ≤ x2611_15008_Tutte G x y := by
  classical
  unfold x2611_15008_Tutte
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun A _ => mul_nonneg
    (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx) _) (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hy) _)

theorem x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux4 {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E)
    (hconn : G.toSimpleGraph.Connected) : x2611_15008_components G = 1 := by
  haveI : Nonempty G.vertexSet := hconn.nonempty
  haveI : Subsingleton G.toSimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent :=
    hconn.preconnected.subsingleton_connectedComponent
  exact Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

theorem x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux5 :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * (2.39 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1.7 : ℝ) ^ k := by
  intro k hk
  by_cases h : k = 1
  · subst k; norm_num
  · apply x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux1 (2.39 : ℝ) (1.7 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) k
    omega


theorem x2611_15008_thm3_a (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (G : Graph V E) (hconn : G.toSimpleGraph.Connected) (hG : G.Loopless)
    (hdensity : (G.edgeSet.ncard : ℝ) ≤ (1.64 : ℝ) * ((G.vertexSet.ncard : ℝ) - 1)) :
    x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 ≤ x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 := by
  have bound : ∀ (H : Graph V E)
      (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → 1 < b →
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) → H.Loopless →
      x2611_15008_Tutte H 1 1 * a ^ (H.vertexSet.ncard - x2611_15008_components H) ≤
        x2611_15008_Tutte H 2 0 * b ^ H.edgeSet.ncard := by
    clear! G
    sorry
  have hn : 1 ≤ G.vertexSet.ncard := by
    have he : G.vertexSet.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨v⟩ := hconn.nonempty
      exact ⟨v.val, v.property⟩
    exact (Set.ncard_pos (Set.toFinite _)).mpr he
  have hm : 25 * G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ 41 * (G.vertexSet.ncard - 1) := by
    have hd : (25 : ℝ) * (G.edgeSet.ncard : ℝ) ≤
        41 * ((G.vertexSet.ncard - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hn, Nat.cast_one]
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hd
  have hp : (1.7 : ℝ) ^ G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ (2.39 : ℝ) ^ (G.vertexSet.ncard - 1) :=
    x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux2 (2.39 : ℝ) (1.7 : ℝ) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      41 25 G.edgeSet.ncard (G.vertexSet.ncard - 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hm
  have hb := bound G (2.39 : ℝ) (1.7 : ℝ) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux5 hG
  rw [x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux4 G hconn] at hb
  have hnonneg := x2611_15008_thm3_a_aux3 G 1 1 le_rfl le_rfl
  have hmul : x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 * (1.7 : ℝ) ^ G.edgeSet.ncard ≤
      x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 * (1.7 : ℝ) ^ G.edgeSet.ncard :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hnonneg).trans hb
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (by positivity : 0 < (1.7 : ℝ) ^ G.edgeSet.ncard)).mp hmul
